environment_audit.verified_postgres_version: PostgreSQL 16.15 on x86_64-pc-linux-musl, compiled by gcc (Alpine 15.2.0) 15.2.0, 64-bit

discrepancy_investigation.origin: Raspberry Pi 5 OS kernel package suffix from earlier mock / evaluation report templates.
discrepancy_investigation.explanation: The kernel suffix 'rpt-rpi-2712' was inadvertently carried over into markdown report headers. The raw environment metadata file (environment_metadata.json) and host system correctly record 'Linux-6.18.59-1-lts-x86_64-with-glibc2.44' running on an Intel Core i5-12450H (x86_64) machine.

metrics_collected: cgroup v2 throttling counters (nr_throttled, throttled_usec, nr_periods)
metrics_not_collected: cgroup v2 storage I/O statistics (io.stat: rbytes, wbytes, riops, wiops)
host disk I/O metrics (iostat, /proc/diskstats, writeback duration)
PostgreSQL WAL statistics (pg_stat_wal: wal_records, wal_fpi, wal_bytes, wal_sync_time)
PostgreSQL checkpoint statistics (pg_stat_bgwriter: checkpoints_timed, checkpoints_req, checkpoint_write_time, checkpoint_sync_time)
PostgreSQL internal lock waits (pg_stat_activity: wait_event, wait_event_type)

unsupported_historical_claims.claim: Single-threaded write performance is completely bounded by synchronous WAL writes (fsync) and disk persistence.
unsupported_historical_claims.reason: Neither fsync duration nor disk I/O latency was measured; assertion relies on external domain assumptions.

unsupported_historical_claims.claim: Monitoring logs confirm this coincided with a PostgreSQL background checkpoint flush dirtying shared buffers, causing temporary fsync stall.
unsupported_historical_claims.reason: Monitoring logs do not capture checkpoint events or buffer dirtying; no pg_stat_bgwriter records exist.

trial_isolation_audit.database_initialization_method: Single container startup; pgbench -i -s 2 executed ONCE at container initialization.
trial_isolation_audit.inter_trial_reset: NONE. Database was neither dropped, truncated, nor re-initialized between trials.
trial_isolation_audit.table_bloat_and_mvcc_churn: During balanced_oltp_tpcb, pgbench_branches (2 rows) and pgbench_tellers (20 rows) underwent 1.35 million updates without intermediate VACUUM FULL. Dead tuple accumulation and vacuum contention occurred unpredictably.
trial_isolation_audit.recommendation_for_future_phases: Harden trial isolation by either restarting fresh containers per profile or executing 'TRUNCATE pgbench_history; CHECKPOINT; VACUUM ANALYZE;' between trials to ensure identical starting conditions.

anomaly_investigation.provenance_correction: Anomaly occurred in Replication 1 (r1), NOT Replication 0 (r0).
anomaly_investigation.audit_verdict: Direct causal evidence is absent. While a background checkpoint flush or host scheduling delay is plausible, the cause cannot be definitively verified without engine logs or I/O statistics.
